result.title: Monte Carlo Tree Search for Classifier Chains
result.summary: Multi-label classification continues to be relevant to a variety of modern tasks. Among other challenges, modern data sets are increasingly large with respect to the number of labels, and these labels may be noisy or missing in the training sets. Label-wise scores and ranking-based metrics have been popular, but optimising exact multi-label evaluation (where a predicted set of labels should match the true set exactly) is particularly relevant for many domains, e.g., in medicine; alongside some measure of confidence. This requires an estimation of joint probability across labels (a model of label dependence; conditioned on each input instance). A family of methods known as probabilistic classifier chains provides such inference. However, these existing varieties either do not scale to a large number of labels or do so by approximating joint via marginal distributions in a way that compromises the estimation of uncertainty for exact match accuracy. We overcome this issue by proposing TSCC; leveraging a Monte Carlo Tree Search methodology to enhance chain inference via an efficient balance between the exploration of label space and the exploration of promising label-set predictions. Results are promising both in terms of predictive and computational performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TSCC，用蒙特卡洛树搜索改进步进式概率分类器链的推断，在标签空间探索与高潜标签集预测之间取得平衡，以更好估计联合概率与精确匹配下的不确定性，并在预测与计算性能上给出初步结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用 MCTS 在逐标签的结构化输出序列上平衡探索与利用、并据此估计不确定性，可能为 LVR 中 latent 推理轨迹的搜索、候选择优与停止决策提供可核查的方法线索，但任务本身是多标签分类，不涉及视觉状态分析。
